items.label: MA-AG civil: Wheelabrator Saugus, Wheelabrator North Andover and Wheelabrator Millbury
items.detail: Settlement filed with a court complaint over ash handling and wastewater violations at three municipal waste incinerators under state hazardous waste, Clean Water Act and wetlands laws; date is the announcement date. One $7.5 million payment by the operator covers all three facilities, so one row; the release says Wheelabrator admits no wrongdoing.
